about.title: Info
about.description: Audio player and library manager: it edits tags and cover art straight into the files, leaves them where they are, and plays them without leaving the window.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language, look and behaviour of the application, and its libraries.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the interface, of the menus and of the messages.

startup.title: Startup and window
startup.description: General settings for how the application starts and how its window behaves.
startup.minimized: Start minimized to the system tray
startup.closeToTray: When the window is closed, leave the application in the system tray
startup.hint: When the application is minimized to the system tray, a click on the icon reopens the window and a right click lets you stop playback or quit the application.

playerBehaviour.title: Player
playerBehaviour.description: Settings for the player and the floating player.
playerBehaviour.keepOpen: Leave the player open and minimized when the track is closed
playerBehaviour.dock: Show the floating player when the app goes to the system tray
playerBehaviour.closeAction: When the floating player is closed
playerBehaviour.progress: Progress bar in the floating player
playerBehaviour.gradient: Background from the cover in the floating player

textSize.title: Text size
textSize.description: Scales the typography across the whole interface.
textSize.preview: Preview of the text at the selected size.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Light or dark appearance, or automatic.
theme.systemHint: The system is currently using the {theme} theme.

accent.title: Accent colour
accent.description: Colour of the controls, buttons and active elements of the interface.
accent.hint: The colour is lightened or darkened automatically so it stays readable on both the light and the dark theme.

ambience.title: Background and glass
ambience.description: Soft background built on the accent colour, and translucent surfaces for depth.
ambience.background: Soft background from the accent colour
ambience.panels: Use the same background on the detail windows
ambience.hint: The second colour of the background comes from the accent, so it changes with it. The two options are independent.

coverGradient.title: Background colour from the cover
coverGradient.description: Use the dominant cover color for the player background and the playing row.

defaultPlayer.title: Default audio player
defaultPlayer.message: Windows requires a manual choice: find TuneLib in default apps and assign the audio formats you want to open here.
defaultPlayer.linuxMessage: On Linux the association is managed by your desktop environment: open its default applications settings, or run this command in a terminal.

importExport.title: Import / Export
importExport.description: Settings for importing and exporting the music library.
importExport.busy: Import running. The other commands stay locked until it ends.

report.summary: {total} tracks read: {added} added, {updated} updated, {skipped} skipped, {missing} missing files.

hints.full: Data and covers included: a larger file, but one that opens without the original tracks.
hints.paths: Only where the files are: the data is read back from those files on import, so they have to still be in place.

libraries.title: Libraries
libraries.description: Settings for managing your music libraries.

coverCache.title: Cover cache
coverCache.description: Cover art is kept on disk, so it does not have to be read out of the files at every start. The cache can be emptied at any time: it rebuilds itself and the library files are left untouched.
coverCache.limit: When the cache goes past {limit}, the covers requested longest ago are removed automatically.

confirm.title: Empty the cover cache?
confirm.message: The covers kept on disk are removed and read from the files again when they are next needed. The tracks of the library are left untouched.

coverCache.failed: The cache could not be emptied.

banners.title: Library messages
banners.description: The summaries that appear at the top of the library — imports, checks, exports — close themselves after the chosen time. A bar under the message shows how long is left.

delete.title: Delete the library?
delete.message: The "{name}" library and its {count} tracks are removed from the list. The audio files stay on disk.

missingInfo.title: Missing data
missingInfo.description: Filter the library by the information that still needs to be completed. Choose All to return to the normal view.
missingInfo.label: Information
missingInfo.result: no tracks found | 1 track found | {count} tracks found
missingInfo.filtered: The view is filtered: only the tracks without {filter} are listed.

defaultPlayerBanner.title: You can use TuneLib as your default player
defaultPlayerBanner.message: Open system settings and choose this app for MP3, FLAC, WAV and the other audio formats.

columnSettings.title: List columns
columnSettings.description: Choose visible columns and drag them to reorder them. Cover and Name always stay first; Duration stays required.
columnSettings.dividersHint: Separates the columns of the list with a thin rule.

empty.title: The library is empty
empty.message: Add your audio files: they stay where they are, only the list is tracked here.
empty.dropHint: You can also drop files and folders onto this window.

noMissingInfo.title: No missing data
noMissingInfo.message: No track matches the missing-data filter.

remove.title: Remove this track?
remove.message: “{title}” leaves the library. The file on disk is not deleted.

report.title: Import result
report.duplicates: 1 file already in the library | {count} files already in the library
report.failed: 1 file not imported | {count} files not imported

duplicates.title: Duplicate tracks
duplicates.description: Tracks held in more than one file, matched by title with its artist or by file name. Removing a copy takes it out of the library: the file stays on disk.
duplicates.empty: No duplicate track: every title is here once.
duplicates.remove: Remove this copy of “{title}” from the library

verification.summary: Verification complete: missing files {missing} out of {total} tracks.

refresh.missing: {count} file is no longer available at the path on record | {count} files are no longer available at the paths on record
refresh.refreshed: {count} tracks edited outside the app were brought up to date
refresh.recovered: Found {count} files that were previously missing
refresh.removeMissingMessage: {count} tracks will be removed from the library. Files on disk will not be deleted.

exportList.title: Export track list
exportList.description: Choose the format and information to include in the file.

errors.shellUnavailable: This feature is only available in the desktop application.
errors.generic: The operation failed. Please try again.
errors.invalidLibraryName: The library name cannot be empty.
errors.duplicateLibraryName: A library with this name already exists.

playback.unavailable: “{title}” cannot be played: the file is not available at the path on record.

importProgress.saving: Adding tracks and saving the library…

bulk.title: Edit {count} tracks
bulk.description: Enable only the fields to apply to every selected track. The track name stays individual.

cover.label: Cover
cover.tooLarge: The cover inside this file weighs {size}, too much to be shown. The file has not been touched: choosing a new image replaces it.

batch.title: Update the album cover?
batch.message: The album "{album}" has {count} other tracks. Apply the same cover change to them too?

errors.yearOutOfRange: Enter a valid year (between 1000 and next year).
errors.coverType: Only PNG or JPEG images are allowed.
errors.coverTooLarge: The image is larger than 5 MB.

errors.missing: The file of this track is no longer on disk.
errors.unsupported: This audio format cannot be played here.
errors.shellUnavailable: Playback is only available in the desktop application.

related.empty: No other track connected to this one in the library.

mini.pin: Keep the mini player always on top
mini.unpin: Stop keeping the mini player on top

confirm.title: Close the mini player?
confirm.message: Choose whether to close only the mini-player window and leave the application in the system tray, or quit the application completely.
